steps.title: Enter South Campus Hall
steps.detail: Walk from the mapped entrance toward the lower passage.

steps.title: Follow the arts tunnel
steps.detail: Stay on the ochre-and-yellow passage toward Arts Lecture Hall.

steps.title: Go up to Arts Lecture Hall
steps.detail: Follow the stair flights and landings to the ground floor.

steps.title: Arrive at Arts Lecture Hall
steps.detail: Continue through the ground-floor corridor to the mapped exit.
